$comment: Mutation arms cutting the types of package anyparse.check.haxe.members. Format and rules: docs/testing.md, Declared arms.

arms.name: M-EAV-CONDITIONAL
arms.note: an occurrence in a branch no build compiled reads nothing

arms.name: M-EAV-FIX-OFF
arms.note: the fix runs without its config key

arms.name: M-EAV-IMPLICIT-ARRIVAL
arms.note: a type with a from cast is weighed

arms.name: M-EAV-LABEL-ALONE
arms.note: a value alone in its group leaves its label behind

arms.name: M-EAV-LATER-IMPLICIT
arms.note: a value a later implicit number follows is removed

arms.name: M-EAV-NAMED-AS-VALUE
arms.find: return namedAsValue(type, ctx) ? 'some code names it as a value' : null;
arms.note: a type handed to a macro as a value is weighed

arms.name: M-EAV-NO-FACTS
arms.find: if (facts == null || reads == null) return true;
arms.replace: if (facts == null || reads == null) return false;
arms.note: without facts an occurrence reads nothing

arms.name: M-EAV-OTHER-TYPE-READ
arms.note: an occurrence the builds typed as another type's value keeps the value

arms.name: M-EAV-MACRO-HOST
arms.note: a type argument of a host a build macro writes is no hand-off

arms.name: M-EAV-UNRECORDED-READ
arms.note: compiled code recording no value at an occurrence reads nothing
